confidence_rationale: Strong, heavily-replicated result (ICLR, first >human-mean Montezuma without demonstrations) that a dedicated RL policy plus a purely unsupervised exploration bonus can clear hard sparse-reward. Directly bears on the live GOV-FANOUT-1 discrimination (is an expert teacher necessary, or is unsupervised exploration merely too weak). Confidence held below 0.8 by domain transfer: Atari pixel hard-exploration at ~1e9 frames and large parallel actor budgets is a very different regime from REE D3 5x5 forage in-budget.
failure_signatures: RND's SOTA on Montezuma required hundreds of parallel environments and ~1.6-2 billion frames; the exploration bonus is a large-compute solution, not a cheap in-budget one -- so 'unsupervised exploration is sufficient' does not imply 'sufficient in REE's per-arm budget'.
RND is susceptible to the same detachment/derailment failure as other novelty bonuses: the bonus fades as states become familiar, so it can under-explore late-appearing bottleneck states.

Gains were confined to the exploration-hard sparse-reward subset (Montezuma, Gravitar, Venture, Private Eye); on Pitfall! it still scored ~0, i.e. some sparse-reward structures resist even a strong unsupervised explorer.

mapping.source_claim_statement: An exploration bonus equal to the prediction error of a network trained to mimic a fixed random network yields state-of-the-art exploration, achieving better-than-average-human performance on Montezuma's Revenge -- the first method to do so without demonstrations or access to the emulator state.
mapping.ree_translation: The H-optim leg the MECH-457 autopsy defers -- a stronger UNSUPERVISED explorer (PPO+entropy / intrinsic motivation) on the same env+input with no expert to clone -- has real precedent for clearing hard sparse-reward. RND is existence-proof that a dedicated RL policy substrate (which MECH-457 asserts REE needs) plus a good exploration bonus can bootstrap competent control from sparse reward alone, so an action-level expert teacher is not logically necessary in general.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Existence in Atari at billion-frame scale is not sufficiency in REE's per-arm compute budget. RND does not tell us whether the SAME env (D3 forage, ceiling 48.05) is clearable by an intrinsic-motivation explorer in-budget -- that is exactly what the H-optim leg must measure. The paper narrows the search space (explorer path is not a dead end) without deciding it.
mapping.source_context: Deep RL, Atari-2600 hard-exploration games, PPO actor-critic with a distillation-error intrinsic reward, pixel observations, massively parallel rollouts.

confidence_components.notes: Venue + replication weight is very high; the discount is entirely transfer -- Atari-at-scale to REE-in-budget. Weighted toward mapping_fidelity because the claim under test is architectural (is a better explorer viable), for which existence-of-a-strong-explorer is the load-bearing datum.
